issues.title: Stuck on 'Starting Mapepire' after upgrading to 3.x
issues.body_excerpt: After upgrading from 2.14.x to 3.0.x, the status bar is stuck showing 'Starting Mapepire' indefinitely. The connection to the IBM i system itself works (port 449 OK) but Mapepire never starts. Restarting VS Code does not help. Disconnecting and reconnecting does not help.

issues.title: Mapepire fails to start after system upgrade - NOXDBSRV in MSGW
issues.body_excerpt: Related issue - NOXDBSRV job enters MSGW state and blocks new Mapepire startup. Fixed in 2.14.1 by adding a pre-startup job check. May have regressed in 3.x.
